== English Virtual Original comparison ==
The 2004 slips give Leebo the Pilot 2 power bonus and add attrition destiny when in battle with Dash. The remaster retains the pilot icon while dropping the piloting bonus, expressly names Dash Rendar, and moves the peeked card to the top of opponent’s Used Pile instead of offering paid Force Pile and loss choices. The early printed name LE-BO2D9 (V) and the later parenthetical name designate the same droid.
